text: Alif, Laam, Raa: Yewtere fii sugu ɗee kalfe yawtiino ka fuɗɗorde cortewol Baqarah. Ndee Alquraanaare ko Deftere nde Men jippini e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, fii yo a yaltinir yimɓe ɓen e keeferaaku e majjere faade gomɗinal e ganndal e peewal diina Lislaamu, ngol laawol Alla On Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake, Yettiniiɗo e kala huunde.
